put.description: Modifies existing markups for a specific company, project, and document.

schema.description: Request body with markups to save

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

payload = "{\"markups\":[{\"xfdf\":\"string\",\"markup_type\":\"string\",\"page_number\":0,\"xfdf_id\":\"string\",\"id\":\"string\",\"page_height\":0,\"page_width\":0,\"updated_at\":\"2019-08-24T14:15:22Z\",\"markup_context\":\"WORKFLOW\",\"group_id\":\"string\",\"pin_id\":\"string\",\"comment_id\":\"string\",\"base_version\":0}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PUT", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/viewer_documents/%7Bviewer_doc_id%7D/markups", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
